text:
Omar: Quick design check: customer reported 'stack teleport' in the routing rules editor when moving items in very long lists. Video attached. Tess: I can reproduce. Dragging from ~20->5 sometimes ends up at 2 after a tiny pause. Virtualization windows look like they're shifting placeholder indices. Greta: Two proposals: (1) suspend live Preview runs while a reorder gesture is active (call it 'Preview suspended'); (2) add a short 100-150ms settle period after drop before we commit to server so animations can finish. Lin: Agree on suspend. Also keyboard users need explicit affordances. Current flow relies on drag emulation with Space which is flaky. Propose a Move menu (press M when a row is focused) with Up/Down/Top/Bottom and hotkeys. Announce exact position after move. Omar: Microinteraction: reduce snap slab near virtualization seams and add a 90ms fade + 110ms translate when items reflow so it feels anchored instead of teleporting. Tess: Copy note: error 'Invalid rule precedence' confuses customers. Suggest: 'Order not applied check for locked rules or circular dependencies.' Toast short variant: 'Order not saved resolve dependencies.' Include a link to the dependency inspector for the long message. Greta: Backend nuance: sim occasionally returns 202 while warming caches which front-end currently treats as error. We should handle 202 as 'processing' and show a subtle inline spinner next to Preview title instead of a red toast. @QA-bot can we enable a short trace for sim ack behavior? QA-bot: Tracing enabled for sim-ack behavior on routing-editor for 48h. Will surface counts of 202 responses. a11y-bot: Accessibility scan: drag-handle contrast low (2.6:1) and interactive target 20px (fail). Recommend hit target >=44px, ensure focus-visible outline meets contrast, role="button" and aria-label on handle, and an aria-live announcement on keyboard moves. Lin: Example aria-live snippet to add to the component library:```html
Moved rule "Block-Proxy" to position 7 of 22
``` Use the exact rule name and positions in the string. Omar: UX question: should Preview update continuously while dragging? My vote is no pause it. Live updates during drag cause flurries of spurious errors. Resume and run once when settle + commit completes. Tess: Also recommend debounce saves by ~120ms and a single poll after 1s if we get 202 back, then surface final state. That should stop the toast flip. Greta: For keyboard-only flow: show small Move Up / Move Down chevrons when a row is focused (visible on focus/hover) and display tooltip with hotkeys (eg. Alt+Shift+Up / Alt+Shift+Down). Ensure Space/Enter also triggers the primary move action and announces position. Lin: Accessibility checklist I'll add to the ticket: increase handle hit target to 44px; ensure icon/stroke contrast >=4.5:1 for non-focus, focus-visible contrast >=3:1; add aria-live announcement; expose Move menu and document hotkeys. Omar: I'll prototype reduced snap sensitivity and the fade/translate animation. Tess can you draft the toast copy and long message with a link to the inspector? Tess: On it. Also adding a small 'Preview paused while editing' badge that sits in the Preview header so it's obvious. Greta: I'll change the client to accept 202 as processing, show inline spinner, debounce the commit, poll once after 1s if needed, and emit the aria-live string after the UI settles. Opening PR tomorrow. Lin: QA: I'll add an automated regression that does deep reorders and asserts we don't see a toast flip from success->error within 2s after drop. Omar: Nice. Sync Friday 9:30am PT to review mocks and accessibility updates. Thanks all! :seedling:
